scope: Read-only two-stage review: spec compliance, then code quality

findings.title: Validate terminal EOF after exactly filling each 206 block
findings.observed: Both first and future lanes accepted exact payload followed by an extra chunk, a transport error, or a missing EOF; six probes each completed all 2097152 bytes with only one read of the bad body
findings.expected: After the bounded block bytes, a timed terminal read must establish EOF before treating the lane as complete; any extra bytes/error/stall aborts the full response

findings.title: Retain a large 200 fallback permit through body consumption
findings.observed: Nine simultaneous same-lease large 200 streams each supplied one byte then stalled; all nine entered upstream fetch before consumption
findings.expected: The ninth large body waits for one of the eight held permits; 200 compatibility still issues one upstream stream per request

findings.title: Reuse a newly published transport for late denials from the same old wave
findings.observed: Three future old-transport 403s staggered by 30ms triggered three refreshes even though every new-transport retry succeeded
findings.expected: A late denial from the replaced old transport reuses the already published fresh transport for its single retry

initial.parentDisposition: Root accepted all three concrete P2 findings and assigned the original audio-proxy owner to fix them
